notes: Coverage: I opened the whole scan once for layout, half_a once and half_b once in that order. Every text block, word ending, accent, punctuation mark, inline formula and display was compared with both witness texts, including all agreements. Crops were then made once per unresolved local place; no whole half was enlarged again and no locus was recropped. This coverage statement is separate from mathematical checking.

Inputs were restricted to the assigned scan007 packet, brief_v06.md, the three specified scan007 source images and this reader’s output folder. No OCR, text recognition, PDF text layer, outside research, other scan, other reader return, records directory or delegation was used.

The sheet is a typescript with darker pen additions, corrections and underlining. The supplied page and packet do not establish the personal identity of the pen writer; inventory descriptions use unnamed hand. There is a pencil 6 at bottom left and no legible upper manuscript page number, heading, date or stated page total. H’s page{6} already carries the archive number and is not counted as an omission.

Layout inventory: two prose paragraphs; the second contains one centred displayed formula and continues beneath it. There is no diagram or independent intentional drawing. The curved strokes beside suivante. and ordinaire attach additions to the text and are represented by inserted at their attachments, not as detached arrows.

The opening paragraph states close prospective relationships between n- and infinity-categories, simplicial/topological objects, and strict Picard categories and truncated chain complexes. Its wording remains tentative: relations qu’on pressent, Il y aurait à s’attendre, pourrait bien. It suggests a common algebraic vision and changes reste à to doit before venir. These are descriptions of what the page says, not proof checks.

The second paragraph proposes studying categories with the two displayed operations, a distributivity datum and suitable compatibilities, with the first structure Picard. It states that pi_0(A) is a commutative unital ring and pi_1(A) a module over it, then asks what further invariants characterize A with all structures. I have not checked that mathematical assertion in this run.

Actual internal line-end divisions joined in the reading include pres-/sent, homóto-/pique, pro-/jectifs, tenso-/riel, évi-/demment, distri-/butivité and fai-/re. The page-initial ent is left untouched; the cancelled Picar is not completed. The high dark fleck after homóto- is explicitly described in an unresolved entry and reading.tex comment; it cannot securely be identified as intentional textual ink.

Main-reader adjudication crops are still required for the three differences settled directly from half_a: u-only underline in commune and the two quote pairs. Their changes rows have empty crop_ids and explicitly state half resolution. Every other claimed witness difference has the local crop ID already supplied.

Several C uncertainties were resolved from underletter anatomy rather than their live-word context: de under pl of plus; or under ro after the clean p in projectifs; str under loi; a under e in provenant de; and the extra cancelled a before i in opérations. The overtyped first syllable of homótopique remains much less secure and is not treated as a settled correction.

Crop metadata records original source-pixel boxes, the common image-processing parameters and actual UTC batch-view start readings from the clock tool. These are batch starts, not invented individual crop-open timestamps. The crop files are evidence views, not OCR output.
No mathematical proof, re-proof, computation, formal certificate or re-use check was performed. math_checks is therefore an empty list.
